Name: Universal Quality Crops Produce More Seeds
Author: TntDove
Description:
[size=4]An incredibly simple mod that makes it so quality crops put into the seed maker will provide more seeds.
Normal crops work like normal
Silver crops give 1 extra seed
Gold crops give 2 extra seeds
Iridium crops give 3 extra seeds
Mixed Seeds and Ancient Seeds are not affected

This SHOULD work with modded crops, as long as they don't have any unique interactions with the seed maker.

No config options (At least not yet).[/size]
